title: Certified Rounded-Gaussian Dither Sampler and Adaptive-Threshold Coupling Ledger

scope.target_distribution: E = nearest(W) for W ~ sigma^-1 exp(-pi w^2 / sigma^2) with exact rational sigma > 0
scope.cdf_identity: F(t) = (1 + erf(sqrt(pi)*(t + 1/2)/sigma))/2 via directed Arb gaussian_radius_box enclosures
scope.adaptive_threshold_union: 4 * (2*B + 2) * 2^-K over all 2*B + 2 binary-search thresholds, never O(log B) * 2^-K
scope.complete_batch_policy: Any single dither or mask abort aborts the entire k-row refresh batch with producer_input=null
